# Understanding

- VONQ needs a scalable exit reporting suite—including a refreshable data cube, dashboards, and supporting documentation—to support its upcoming M&A sale process and associated investor communications.
- There is currently a lack of investor-ready reporting, creating risk in presenting a credible, data-backed equity narrative to potential acquirers and advisors.
- Data gaps exist across source systems, and the Qlik Warehouse may not fully support all KPIs required for stakeholder alignment during the exit.
- Manual or one-off data ingestion is required for some source systems, as not all have automated integration with the Qlik Warehouse; recurring data refresh will be necessary during the transaction.
- Required capabilities include equity narrative definition, a prioritised KPI framework, dashboard mock-ups, data feasibility assessment, conceptual data model design, tooling recommendations, and a phased implementation roadmap.
- Automations are needed for data ingestion and refresh pipelines from Finance, CRM, and ERP source systems into the Qlik Warehouse.
- Mandatory integrations must connect the Finance System, CRM, ERP, and legacy data sources (for at least three years of trended data) with the Qlik Warehouse.
- The primary users of the exit reporting suite are senior leadership, exit advisors (Barclays), and potential acquirers/investors.
